title: Warzon trophy
wikitext:
[[File:Qhlan2017 Warzon trophy.jpg|frameless|right]] The prize consists of a beautiful trophy and a some alcoholic bewerages funded by [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Warzon]], a winner of the trophy has to be a '''duelplayer''' that have played very '''entertaining''' throughout a certain tournament. Supreme judge is warzon who with the help of his scouts at the lan will decide the worthy winner. The Warzon trophy was produced and given away by [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[warzon]] for the first time at [[QHlan]] 11. The price consisted of 120cans of beer and the statue made by warzon. [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Mawe]] won the first award. May the fylla be with him.
But things didn't go as smooth as possible, cause the trophy was under attack from [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[psykopatrik]] and it was almost stolen.
